$comment: Motion direction for a Recast render. Hand-maintained — not a generated file.
Claude authors the render's GSAP timeline itself and cannot see the Studio, so
motion only reaches it as sentences in the prompt (see the `wants` array in
bin/rm-studio.mjs). Before this file existed there were no such sentences, which
is why every deck moved differently: the panel sent chrome, background and
captions, and left motion to whatever the model felt like that run.
The `brand` preset is not invented. It is read off the eight transition tokens
in brand/optics/optics.css, which are the only motion the design system ships:
That is a narrow, consistent signature: 120-400ms, ease-in or ease-in-out, one
or two properties at a time, and no bounce, elastic or back easing anywhere in
the system. The sentences below say exactly that, in the vocabulary the
hyperframes skill uses to write a timeline.

brand.label: Brand — Optics motion
brand.hint: The system's own signature: short, eased, nothing bouncy.
direction: Motion follows Optics: every transition runs 120-400ms with ease-in or ease-in-out (GSAP `power2.in` / `power2.inOut`).
Never use bounce, elastic, back, or spring easing, and never spin, flip or rotate an element more than 2 degrees — the design system contains no such motion.
Animate opacity and transform only. Nothing travels more than 40px, and nothing scales past 1.04.
Reveal a group as a group: stagger its items 60-80ms rather than animating them one at a time.
Once a slide has arrived it holds still. No looping, drifting, pulsing or ambient movement under the narration.

minimal.label: Minimal — cuts and fades
minimal.hint: Nothing moves. Use when the content is dense or the narration is fast.
direction: Motion is cuts and cross-fades only: 150ms opacity transitions, ease-in.
Nothing translates, scales, rotates or staggers. No element moves position at any point.
Slides cut between each other on the beat of the narration.

energetic.label: Energetic — quicker, more travel
energetic.hint: Same easing family, shorter and larger. For promos, not walkthroughs.
direction: Motion is quick: 90-200ms transitions with ease-out (GSAP `power3.out`).
Still no bounce, elastic, back or spring easing, and still no spinning or flipping.
Elements may travel up to 80px and scale to 1.08. Stagger a group's items 40ms.
Movement stops once a slide is in place — the energy is in the arrival, not in ambient drift.
